title: 第1314章 闭关重修八门两章合一第1313章 祖爷爷我爹也被打了两章合一
slug: 末世我的女人有亿点强
lines: 天缺府的青年听到林羽的名字，以及四周的议论声，浑身颤抖了起来。
他满目狰狞的大吼了起来：“祖爷爷，他是林羽，他就是那个要和父亲抢月华公主的人，快杀了他！”
“只要杀了他，就没有人和我们争了，月华公主就是我天缺府的人了。”
“我要他死，一定要他死啊！”
青年如同发疯的疯狗一般，被林羽的名字和四周的议论声刺激到了。
直接就大喊大叫了起来，眼眸中充满了杀意和愤怒。
一旁。
他的父亲小天缺王听到这个名字也呆住了。
原本他已经老老实实的呆在一旁，今日之事已经让他丢尽了脸面，恨不得找个地缝躲起来了。
堂堂天缺府未来的接班人，一百三十多岁的的年纪，今日却被一个五六十岁的年轻一代打的遍体鳞伤，他对林羽的恨意早就直冲天际了。
而今……
更是听到林羽的真名，知晓其就是抢了月华公主的罪魁祸首，顿时就让他感觉头顶绿油油的，再也绷不住了，跟着大声的开口：“祖爷爷，请为孩儿做主啊！”
这一大一小两父子开口，如同小孩一般，让天缺王的脸色更加难看了。
他抬头又看向林羽，眼中跳动着寒光。
“天缺王，你可不要做傻事啊！”
大监浑身气息涌动，有些警惕的开口。
林羽可是月华公主定下的夫婿，是玉京皇室棋盘中极为重要的一环，不容有失。
看着拦在前方的大监，天缺王眼中寒芒跳动。
下一刻，他右手猛然挥出。
所有人都以为他终究还是要动手的时候，却听见两道清脆的声音响起，伴随着两道惨叫声，两道黑影划破天空，重重的插入了之前的那片废墟之中。
仔细一看。
飞出的两人，却是天缺王的两个后代，
小天缺王和他的儿子。
这一幕，让所有人都呆住了。
谁也没想到，在得知是林羽之后，天缺王不但没有继续出手，反而将自家最器重的两个后辈打飞了出去。
“啊啊啊……”
“祖爷爷，这是为什么啊？”
杀猪般的惨叫声响起。
那青年从废墟中冒出头来，全都是血。
他人都麻了，本以为能看到祖爷爷只手镇天，将可恶的林羽镇压，将那扁毛畜生炖肉吃，不曾想祖爷爷那磨盘般的大手却是朝着他的来上招呼。
不仅是他，连自己的父亲，威名赫赫的小天缺王都挨了一个大鼻兜，差点没被打成肉泥。
“不成器的东西，被本座滚回去好好反省。”
天缺王冷哼一声，充满杀意的瞥了林羽一眼后，瞬间消失不见。
只留下废墟中两个丢人现眼的家伙。
林羽看着这一幕，也是嘴角抽了抽，本以为要和接近霸主级别的存在过过手呢，没想到发生了如此戏剧性的一幕。
不过。
这一幕，却让他内心更加警惕了起来。
这足以说明月华公主，甚至是玉京皇室对他的图谋很大。
幸好他是做足了准备而来。
content_en:
The young man in Tianque Mansion trembled all over when he heard Lin Yu's name and the comments around him.
He roared with ferocious eyes: "Grandpa Zu, he is Lin Yu, he is the one who wants to snatch Princess Yuehua from his father, kill him quickly!"
"As long as we kill him, no one will fight with us. Princess Yuehua will become a member of my Tianque Mansion."
"I want him to die, I must die!"
The young man was like a mad dog, stimulated by Lin Yu's name and the comments around him.
He started yelling immediately, his eyes filled with murderous intent and anger.
aside.
His father, King Xiao Tianque, was stunned when he heard the name.
Originally, he had been staying aside, but today's incident had already made him lose face. He wished he could find a crack in the ground to hide.
The future successor of the Tianque Mansion, who is more than one hundred and thirty years old, was beaten black and blue by a younger generation in his fifties and sixties today. His hatred for Lin Yu has already reached the sky.
Now...
When he heard Lin Yu's real name and knew that he was the culprit who robbed Princess Yuehua, he immediately felt a green glow on his head. He couldn't hold it any longer, and said loudly: "Grandpa, please make the decision for the child!"
The father and son, the older one and the younger one, spoke like children, which made King Tianque's expression even more ugly.
He raised his head and looked at Lin Yu again, with a cold light dancing in his eyes.
"King Tianque, don't do anything stupid!"
The supervisor's breath surged all over his body, and he spoke with some vigilance.
Lin Yu was Princess Yuehua's chosen husband. He was an extremely important part of the Yujing royal family's chessboard and could not be missed.
Looking at the eunuch standing in front of him, King Tianque's eyes trembled with coldness.
The next moment, he suddenly swung out his right hand.
Just when everyone thought he was going to take action after all, they heard two crisp sounds, accompanied by two screams, and two black shadows cut through the sky and penetrated heavily into the ruins before.
Take a closer look.
The two people who flew out were the two descendants of King Tianque.
King Xiao Tianque and his son.
This scene made everyone stunned.
No one expected that after learning that it was Lin Yu, King Tianque not only did not continue to take action, but instead knocked away his two most valued juniors.
"Ahhhh..."
"Grandpa, why is this?"
A scream like a slaughtering pig rang out.
The young man emerged from the ruins, covered in blood.
Everyone else was numb. They thought they could see Grandpa Grandpa holding the sky with one hand, suppressing the hateful Lin Yu, and stewing the flat-haired beast to eat, but they never thought that Grandpa Grandpa's big hand like a millstone was greeting him.
Not only him, but his own father, the famous Little Tianque King, also got a big slap in the nose and was almost beaten to a pulp.
"This useless thing should be sent back to me to reflect on it."
King Tianque snorted coldly, glanced at Lin Yu with murderous intent, and disappeared in an instant.
Only two shameful guys were left in the ruins.
Lin Yu's mouth twitched as he watched this scene. He thought he was going to fight someone close to the overlord level, but he didn't expect such a dramatic scene to happen.
but.
This scene made him even more wary.
This is enough to show that Princess Yuehua and even the Yujing royal family have great plans for him.
Fortunately, he came well prepared.
